notes: Editable source for public/models/2649-bka.glb. Edit values, then run: npm run model:2649-bka (scripts/build-shoe-model.mjs).
t runs from 0 (heel back) to 1 (toe tip) along the outsole length. Heights are mm above the ground; widths are mm from the heel-toe axis.
Values were fitted to 03-side.jpg and 04-top.jpg silhouettes and checked visually against 02-angled.jpg (see README.md and compreport.txt E.4).
Model coordinates: metres, +Y up, toe +Z, right shoe with the medial side at +X, origin on the ground at mid-footprint.

footprint.comment: Outsole edge half-widths in mm, measured from the heel-toe axis (x = 0). Lateral is -X, medial is +X.

upperBulge.comment: Extra outward bulge of the upper walls (mm, peaks mid-height) over the narrower sole waist, from the top view.

ground.comment: Height of the outsole underside. Heel seat 13 mm on the heel block, arch curve, flat ball, toe spring.

heelCup.comment: Near the heel the walls curl in radially around the heel-cup centre (t = centreT), so the counter wraps forward into a rounded cup. Blends out by endT.

heelCurve.comment: Forward offset (mm) of the heel counter by height above the sole top; fades out by fadeT. Rounds the rear profile.

ridge.comment: Top line of the closed vamp (tongue edge at the throat, then toward the toe).

collar.comment: Top edge of the opening (collar line) from the heel back to the throat.

collarSideOffset.comment: Per-side collar height offset (mm): the lateral quarter is cut higher than the medial one (side and 3/4 photos show only a thin lining strip on the lateral side).

quarterCurl.comment: How far the quarter walls curl in at the collar: virtual ridge = collar + k*(collar - sole top). Smaller k curls more (heel wraps in).

sectionExponent.comment: Cross-section roundness: 1 = elliptical, < 1 boxier. Kept <= 1 so the toe never forms a crease.

heelSeam.comment: [t, height above sole top mm]; negative height = mm below the collar
